title: WebAssembly - Overlong call_indirect immediate
product-requirement: Terminals MUST accept overlong LEB128 immediates in call_indirect (Lime1)
specification: Terminals MUST validate WebAssembly modules whose call_indirect instruction encodes its table index immediate as a non-canonical (overlong) LEB128
assertion: WebAssembly.validate accepts a module containing call_indirect with a 4-byte LEB128 encoding of the table index 0

changelog.summary: Initial creation of call_indirect overlong-immediate feature test
